# Universal Unit Catalogue — every unit type the 5 Classes allow

*Generated by `unit_calculator.py catalogue` · points at ×1.5 scale (1,000-pt standard game) · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL.*

These are **chassis**: Faction 21 (Rift-Stalker) plays them as-is, and every other faction starts from one, then applies its Stat DNA and abilities (FACTION_DESIGN_GUIDE.md §1.2–1.3).
